content: Root cause: The bug was caused by incorrect handling of D-Bus API properties related to "SystemCallFilter" and "RestrictAddressFamilies". Specifically, the code was attempting to manipulate the wrong data structures (address_families instead of syscall_filter) and had issues with memory management for string arrays. The patch corrected these issues by ensuring the correct data structures were used and properly initializing and managing the string arrays, which resolved the D-Bus API functionality.
